product_evaluation_context.evaluation_purpose: Test whether a response-process simulator predicts held-out developer operation paths, reveal transitions and a separately randomized case-fact response better than simple and equally calibrated persona-prompted baselines.

question_or_hypothesis: A calibrated, fact-constrained response-process simulator predicts held-out developer path/reveal distributions and response to one operative case-fact change better than smoothed empirical, neutral-LLM and equally calibrated persona-prompted baselines without losing rare valid paths or access-mode reliability.
conditions: Separate synthetic defect-search utility from human-distribution prediction
Treat marginal path fit and randomized case-fact intervention fidelity as distinct claims
Freeze exact case/model/prompt/state taxonomy and predictions before human holdout
Use permissioned developer data with independent blind process coding and person/case-family splits

variables_or_interventions.name: simulator model
variables_or_interventions.planned_value: simple empirical baseline, unprofiled LLM, untuned and matched-calibration persona LLM, sampled decision-context model, response-state model and distribution predictor

variables_or_interventions.name: case family and response mode
variables_or_interventions.planned_value: versioned, counterbalanced or held-out where sample precision allows

variables_or_interventions.name: separate research case-fact allocation
variables_or_interventions.planned_value: two independently reviewed variants differing in one operative fact, randomized only after consent and precision review

environment: Brazil-only mixed software-developer formative pilot after purpose, privacy, consent, access and research-protocol decisions.
prerequisites: Independent coders, pilot precision plan and holdout split
Separate precision and comparability review for the randomized case-fact module
stop_rules: Holdout leakage, rare-valid-path loss or material access-mode error
limitations: No human response corpus or calibrated simulator
No employment-selection inference or validated score follows from simulator alignment
Measurement Method carrier and typed relations remain to be prepared
claim_ceiling: Candidate experiment design only; no collection permission, human alignment result or hiring authority.
